headline: SEEDHA VAAR · Nadda ka Congress aur INDI par tanz
caption:
JP Nadda Congress INDI Alliance Rahul Gandhi vote chori par tanz 🇮🇳
BJP neta JP Nadda ne X par likha ki Congress aur uske neta pratipaksh ek abodh balak ki tarah vyavahar karte hain.
Unke mutabik jaise school ka bachcha galti se pass ho jaye toh khud ko hoshiyar kehta hai, aur fail ho toh master ko kharab bolta hai, INDI Alliance bhi aisa hi karta hai.
INDI bloc ke saansad 'vote chori' ke virodh mein Parliament se Rashtrapati Bhavan tak march nikaal chuke hain. Jeet par khushi, haar par system ko dosh: kya yahi double standard hai?
Sehmat ho toh YES, nahi toh NO likho 👇
